verdict.rationale: The product is a set of agent skills, so it is operated by talking to a coding agent. Skill descriptions are natural-language triggers: TDD activates when the user "wants to build features or fix bugs test-first" or mentions "red-green-refactor", and grilling activates when the user "wants to stress-test their thinking". Skills such as grilling and triage then run as conversational interviews, and the set works across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Copilot. Missing for 10: no hands-on evidence that natural-language phrasing actually triggers the right skill (the runtime probe only verified installation); the documented primary invocation is slash commands rather than free-form requests; installation and updates still go through CLI commands.
